messages:
sam-docs: Quick thread 1: I drafted a short section showing JSON-level API + JS SDK examples for Dedicated provisioning and a lint rule note about cooldown units. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1499 Please skim for accuracy.
leo-cli: nice. can you include a raw API POST example (we had a customer hitting unit conversion bugs)?
sam-docs: added both. API payload sample uses cooldown_ms to avoid ambiguity. snippet:
```json
{
  \"kind\": \"ScalePolicy\",
  \"metadata\": { \"name\": \"burst-tenant-7\" },
  \"spec\": {
    \"minReplicas\": 1,
    \"maxReplicas\": 12,
    \"cooldown_ms\": 120000,
    \"metrics\": [{ \"type\": \"RequestRate\", \"target\": 220 }],
    \"isolation\": { \"selector\": { \"redwood.tenant.isolation\": \"team-7\" } }
  }
}
```
anya-qa: please add a small QA checklist: how to reproduce the units bug (send cooldown_seconds) and expected server error or auto-conversion behavior. I can paste commands.
maria-pm: legal reminder: avoid absolutes in SLA examples. use "typical expected" or "observed" phrasing. Also ask localization team to check the console copy for the Spanish build.
eng-runtime-bot: note: runtime accepts cooldown_ms; it will accept cooldown_seconds alias for a single release but will log a deprecation warning. metrics.type: prefer RequestRate; QPS alias supported. isolation.selector keys follow convention redwood.tenant.isolation.
leo-cli: added a tiny JS SDK example too:
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient();
await client.scalePolicies.create({
  name: 'burst-tenant-7',
  minReplicas: 1,
  maxReplicas: 12,
  cooldownMs: 120000,
  metrics: [{ type: 'RequestRate', target: 220 }],
  isolation: { selector: { 'redwood.tenant.isolation': 'team-7' } }
});
```
anya-qa: QA steps added: send raw JSON with cooldown_seconds, verify deprecation warning in logs, verify preemption log string capacity_unavailable_preemption_possible under high load.
sam-docs: also found two broken anchors in the dedicated provisioning TOC during link check. fixed paths and added redirect notes for older links.
devx-bot: Preview deployed for PR 1499: https://deploys.redwood.com/preview/1499 (expires in 7 days). CI: lint-ok, spellcheck: 2 warnings.
maria-pm: small UX ask: in the example text change "pin workloads" to "assign affinity" to match console language.
sam-docs: updated wording and will merge after eng-runtime final ack + devx CI green. thanks!
